caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional figure of a man dressed in full suit armor, including a helmet with a large plume on top. The armor is colored mostly in gold and beige tones, with some green highlights visible at the joints and straps. The figure is standing on an ornately carved base that resembles wood with curving scrollwork, colored in brown and gold. The man's head is turned to the side, and his right arm is bent across his body, while his left arm hangs at his side. Over his left shoulder, he wears a yellowish cape that drapes down his back. The figure is mounted against a dark, almost black, vertical panel that contrasts with the lighter color of the armor and cape. The entire composition is centered on a plain, beige background with visible signs of aging or discoloration, and a small monogram is located near the bottom right corner.
title: Figurehead
